notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.9
notes.notes:
Update includes:


 Animations have been added to the UI buttons, along with a new animation for increasing and decreasing the number of cutting boards.
  The hint button, which was similar in function to the menu button, has been removed from the left sidebar. The number of available hint points is now displayed under the menu button.
 The layout of the graphical elements on the British and Chinese menus has also been slightly adjusted.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.8
notes.notes:
Update includes:


 In response to numerous negative feedback, the descriptions of the hints for each dish have been reviewed and rewritten in many cases to make it easier for players to progress, and grammatical errors have been corrected.
 In the discovery view, it has been fixed that the text of some dishes was overlapping with the icon of the discovered ingredient or dish in the center.
 The main menu has received a new design.
 The recipe descriptions in the info and ingredients panel UI have been updated.
 The background of the settings and pause window UI has been changed.
 When individual restaurants are loaded, the name of the current restaurant is displayed during the transition.
 The preparation of chocolate sauce in Hungarian cuisine has been changed, and the hint description has also been updated.
 The title and description of the discovery text have been swapped when discovering pulled pork.
 On the main screen, the "remove" button for discovered ingredients/dishes has been changed to "serve."
 The preparation of mac&cheese in American cuisine has changed, and the hint description has also been updated.
 The preparation of buffalo chicken in American cuisine has changed, and the hint description has also been updated.
 Discovered ingredients and dishes can no longer be removed from the frame.
 The tutorial text has been made much more pleasant, and the design of the text bubble has been changed.
 The name of the wrap in the fast food restaurant has been changed to chicken wrap.
 A level selector has been added, where previous levels can be played again.
 The counter that tracks inventory and discovered dishes in the German cuisine has been fixed.
 The corn dog can no longer be discovered in the German cuisine.
 In the tutorial, it sometimes happened that the batter was put into the inventory twice, it has been fixed.
 The preparation of túrós csusza has changed, and the hint description has also been updated.
 The preparation of pizza dough has changed, and the hint description has also been updated.


Cheat codes

Cheat codes were added to the game because the level selector required changes to the save system. The new update is able to handle previous saves, but in case of any problems, if someone finds themselves with a lost save, they won't have to start the game from the beginning. It is recommended to delete saves from the settings menu before using codes.

In the main menu, enter the correct text to load the specified level immediately:

 pulledpork -Amerikai álom
 chowder - Quenns' classic
 pretzel - Hungry Sausage Inn
 macaron - The long night
 peking - China Sun
 goulash - Folk Tale
 tiramisu - Little Italy

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.7
notes.notes:
A number of English spelling mistakes have been fixed.
 When you are clicking on the "Recipe" button next to the discovered meal, the name of the food is displayed correctly in the recipe book
 In the tutorial when you discovering the batter and clicked on the "Slot3" button, it will not longer add the batter twice to the inventory 
 When you discover a new meal it will no longer visible twice in the recipe book (American cuisine - steak)
 Full screen mode and resolution settings are also available in-game, not just in the main menu
 Number of foods that can be prepared showed more by 1 than the maximum in the case of German cuisine, (corn dog now can not be prepared on this level) 
 When you discover a new meal/ingredients, the pop-up window's button text changed to "OK" from "Collect"
 Level selection feature is currently in progress

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.6
notes.notes:
The saving system now fixed
 The preparation of the french toast has been changed 
 The description of the tip for the french toast has been changed
 Tip utilization window will no longer pop up for the meals that already had been prepared in the American kitchen
 Discovered food will be automatically placed from the frame to the inventory in the main view, if one of the slot is increased or reduced
 The name of Spaghetti and Meatballs has been fixed on the Italian menu

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.5
notes.notes:
In the German kitchen, the Cabbage and Sausage was simplified, so there is no need to make another ingredient for it
 Description of pancake soup tip changed 
 The search bar over the inventory is already working properly 
 The Beef Rouladen tip description shows another food tip text, it now fixed
 In the case of the Italian menu, when viewing the previously finished menus, the fast food menu could not be seen, which was also fixed
 In view of a description of a real recipe for a food, if you click on the menu button, the real recipe's graphics no longer hanging on the menu 
 the tip description of the Dobos cake and the Chimney Cake was replaced, it also fixed 
 On the Italian menu, the risotto and the meatball spaghetti are already on a plate, not hanging in the air 
 In the recipe book, it can be scrolling faster in the frame
 The Stuffed Potato name is corrected on the English menu 
 The name of Beef Bourguignon is corrected on the French menu


Coming Soon:

 All meal tips are currently under review, some of them may be replaced in the future

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.4
notes.notes:
In the tutorial mode, each game element is more clearly presented, in order to make it easier to master the game bacics.
 In the meal discover screen you can no longer move out the dish/ingredients from the center box
 The arrangement of elements and question marks in the fast-food menu improved, so it is more clearer to which description which food belongs to
 When clicking on a dish to check the recipe description, the meal's name appears at the left side as a header
 The game start with the last selected language option
 At the American level, you start with only the ingredients which required to finish the menu
 The fonts size of the recipes description now unified
 Fixed the bug that prevents the getting tip points (in every kitchen if you prepare a certain number of foods, you get another hit point) 
 If we had not waited until the animation of the save game to finish and we had clicked on the resume game button, then we clicked to pause menu again, the save game animation was re-played even though we did not save game, also patched. 
 The text that appears in the preparation of chicken paprikas has been fixed
 The name of food in the recipe book no longer slips into the image of your own or other food 
 Corn graphic has been replaced


Known problem: 
The search function above the inventory has been deactivated, because in some cases it freezes the game

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.3 (Achievements)
notes.notes:
The achievements are available in the game
 You only need 2 ingredients to make a Mac & Cheese (previously needs 3 ingredients)
  The graphic in the main menu has been redesigned

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.2
notes.notes:
The ingredients of the meal recipe and the recipe description no longer hang over the menu 
 New filter is available for the inventory which only shows the ingredients 
 After using Alt + Tab,  it will not start over the currently played music in the game 
 A new button has appeared in the menu selector (when reviewing previous menus), which allows you to jump directly to the menu related to the current level 
 Double-clicking on items on the cutting board is no longer available

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.1
notes.notes:
The names of the lángos, lecsó and egg drop soup now visible in the in-game recipe book.
  For some recipes, the recipe description could not be read completely, this has been corrected
